backlog_metadata.source: REQUIREMENTS_V4.md v4.0 (REQUIREMENTS_V3.md v3.0 + PRODUCT_VISION_V4.md v4.0 + PRODUCT_VISION_V5_ITERATION2.md v5.0)
backlog_metadata.source_version: P02 v3.0 + CR-027 + team decisions TD-21 to TD-30 (2026-11-09)
backlog_metadata.planning_fields_note: priority, story_points, release, sprint and assigned_developers are reserved for P03 and left null or empty.

global_requirements.note: Apply to all items. NFR-006 to NFR-008 apply to EPIC-009 items.

status_values.COMMITTED: In scope of iteration 2 by team decision (TD-30). Not a priority or sprint assignment.
status_values.CONDITIONAL: Optional in iteration 2 if capacity remains (TD-30).

iteration_2.note: Team iteration decision recorded by P02; priority, story_points, release, sprint and assigned_developers remain reserved for P03.

epics.name: Accounts and Access
epics.description: Self-registration as a pet owner or as a provider, sign-in choosing the account type, access to the interface of that type, and sign-out.

epics.name: Pet Management
epics.description: Registration and maintenance of the pet owner's pets.

epics.name: Provider Profile and Working Hours
epics.description: The provider's public profile and the days and hours in which it accepts appointments.

epics.name: Provider Catalog
epics.description: Publication and maintenance of the provider's services and products, with prices.

epics.name: Search and Discovery
epics.description: Text search of services and products across all providers in Bogotá, species filter, and provider profiles.

epics.name: Appointment Scheduling
epics.description: Booking of one-hour appointments for a pet within the provider's working hours, at the clinic or at home.

epics.name: Appointment Management
epics.description: Viewing, cancelling and rescheduling appointments, by the owner and by the provider; automatic cancellations.

epics.name: Product Ordering
epics.description: Direct ordering of one product per order, in a chosen quantity, to the owner's address without payment; order statuses, order cancellation and a product stock indicator.

epics.name: Voice Search and Assistant
epics.description: Search by voice, and a read-only assistant that pet owners can ask by voice or text about providers, offerings, prices, hours and their own appointments, with answers read aloud.

items.title: Sign up as a pet owner with my first pet

user_story.i_want: to create an account with my name, email and password and the data of at least one pet
user_story.so_that: I can use the platform to find services and book appointments for my pet

acceptance_criteria.given: a person without a pet owner account
acceptance_criteria.when: they submit a name, an email, a password of at least 8 characters and one pet with at least its name, species, age and breed
acceptance_criteria.then: a pet owner account is created with that pet registered

acceptance_criteria.given: a person completing pet owner sign-up
acceptance_criteria.when: they try to finish without registering any pet
acceptance_criteria.then: the account is not created and they are told that at least one pet is required

acceptance_criteria.given: a person completing pet owner sign-up
acceptance_criteria.when: the name, email or password, or the pet's name, species, age or breed, is missing
acceptance_criteria.then: the account is not created and the missing field is indicated

acceptance_criteria.given: an email that already belongs to another pet owner account
acceptance_criteria.when: a person tries to sign up as a pet owner with that email
acceptance_criteria.then: the account is not created (P02-ASM-002)

acceptance_criteria.given: a pet owner account has just been created
acceptance_criteria.when: its stored credentials are inspected
acceptance_criteria.then: the password is not stored in plain text

acceptance_criteria.given: an email that belongs to a provider account
acceptance_criteria.when: a person signs up as a pet owner with that email
acceptance_criteria.then: the pet owner account is created

acceptance_criteria.given: a person registering a pet
acceptance_criteria.when: they choose the pet's species
acceptance_criteria.then: only dog or cat can be chosen

acceptance_criteria.given: a person completing pet owner sign-up
acceptance_criteria.when: the password has fewer than 8 characters
acceptance_criteria.then: the account is not created and the password is indicated as too short

user_story.i_want: to create a provider account indicating which of the two I am and, for a clinic, its address
user_story.so_that: I can publish my services and products to pet owners

acceptance_criteria.given: a person without a provider account
acceptance_criteria.when: they submit a name, an email, a password of at least 8 characters and the provider type (clinic or independent veterinarian) and, for a clinic, its address
acceptance_criteria.then: a provider account of that type is created

acceptance_criteria.given: a person completing provider sign-up
acceptance_criteria.when: they do not indicate the provider type
acceptance_criteria.then: the account is not created and the missing type is indicated

acceptance_criteria.given: an email that already belongs to another provider account
acceptance_criteria.when: a person tries to sign up as a provider with that email
acceptance_criteria.then: the account is not created (P02-ASM-002)

acceptance_criteria.given: a provider account has just been created
acceptance_criteria.when: its stored credentials are inspected
acceptance_criteria.then: the password is not stored in plain text

acceptance_criteria.given: an email that belongs to a pet owner account
acceptance_criteria.when: a person signs up as a provider with that email
acceptance_criteria.then: the provider account is created

acceptance_criteria.given: a person completing provider sign-up
acceptance_criteria.when: the password has fewer than 8 characters
acceptance_criteria.then: the account is not created and the password is indicated as too short

acceptance_criteria.given: a person signing up as a clinic
acceptance_criteria.when: they do not enter an address
acceptance_criteria.then: the account is not created and the address is indicated as required

acceptance_criteria.given: a person signing up as an independent veterinarian
acceptance_criteria.when: they do not enter an address
acceptance_criteria.then: the provider account is created

user_story.i_want: to sign in with my email and password, choosing the account type I want to enter as
user_story.so_that: I can use the interface that corresponds to that account type

acceptance_criteria.given: a registered pet owner
acceptance_criteria.when: they sign in as a pet owner with the correct email and password
acceptance_criteria.then: they reach the pet owner interface

acceptance_criteria.given: a registered provider
acceptance_criteria.when: they sign in as a provider with the correct email and password
acceptance_criteria.then: they reach the provider interface

acceptance_criteria.given: a registered user
acceptance_criteria.when: they sign in with an incorrect email or password, or as an account type they have not registered
acceptance_criteria.then: access is not granted

acceptance_criteria.given: a signed-in user of one account type
acceptance_criteria.when: they try to use a function of the other account type
acceptance_criteria.then: access to that function is denied

acceptance_criteria.given: a person with a pet owner account and a provider account under the same email
acceptance_criteria.when: they sign in choosing one of the two types
acceptance_criteria.then: they reach the interface of the account of that type

acceptance_criteria.given: a signed-in user
acceptance_criteria.when: 60 minutes pass without activity, or 12 hours pass since they signed in
acceptance_criteria.then: their next action requires signing in again

user_story.i_want: to register another pet
user_story.so_that: I can book services for it

acceptance_criteria.given: a signed-in pet owner
acceptance_criteria.when: they submit a new pet with at least its name, species, age and breed
acceptance_criteria.then: the pet is added to their list of pets

acceptance_criteria.given: a signed-in pet owner adding a pet
acceptance_criteria.when: the pet's name, species, age or breed is missing
acceptance_criteria.then: the pet is not added and the missing field is indicated

acceptance_criteria.given: a signed-in pet owner adding a pet
acceptance_criteria.when: they choose its species
acceptance_criteria.then: only dog or cat can be chosen

user_story.i_want: to see the list of my registered pets
user_story.so_that: I can check, edit or remove them and choose one when booking

acceptance_criteria.given: a signed-in pet owner with registered pets
acceptance_criteria.when: they open their list of pets
acceptance_criteria.then: they see each of their pets with its name and registered data

acceptance_criteria.given: a signed-in pet owner who has removed all their pets
acceptance_criteria.when: they open their list of pets
acceptance_criteria.then: they are told that no pets are registered

acceptance_criteria.given: two different pet owners
acceptance_criteria.when: one of them opens their list of pets
acceptance_criteria.then: only their own pets are shown

user_story.i_want: to edit the data of one of my pets
user_story.so_that: the information about my pet stays correct

acceptance_criteria.given: a signed-in pet owner viewing one of their pets
acceptance_criteria.when: they change one of its fields and save
acceptance_criteria.then: the pet shows the updated data

acceptance_criteria.given: a signed-in pet owner editing a pet
acceptance_criteria.when: they leave its name, species, age or breed empty and save
acceptance_criteria.then: the change is not saved and the field is indicated

user_story.i_want: to remove a pet from my account
user_story.so_that: my list only shows the pets I still have

acceptance_criteria.given: a signed-in pet owner with several pets
acceptance_criteria.when: they remove one of them
acceptance_criteria.then: the pet no longer appears in their list and cannot be chosen for new appointments

acceptance_criteria.given: a signed-in pet owner with only one pet
acceptance_criteria.when: they remove it
acceptance_criteria.then: the pet is removed and the owner cannot book appointments until they register a pet

acceptance_criteria.given: a pet with upcoming appointments
acceptance_criteria.when: its owner removes it
acceptance_criteria.then: those appointments are cancelled and shown as cancelled to the owner and the provider

user_story.i_want: to set my name, my contact phone and email and my address (mandatory for a clinic, optional for an independent veterinarian)
user_story.so_that: pet owners can identify and reach me

acceptance_criteria.given: a signed-in provider
acceptance_criteria.when: they save a name, a phone, an email and an address
acceptance_criteria.then: their public profile shows that information

acceptance_criteria.given: a signed-in independent veterinarian
acceptance_criteria.when: they save their profile without an address
acceptance_criteria.then: the profile is saved and shown without an address

acceptance_criteria.given: a signed-in clinic
acceptance_criteria.when: it tries to save its profile without an address
acceptance_criteria.then: the profile is not saved and the address is indicated as required; the clinic can change its address but not remove it

items.title: Set my working days and hours

user_story.i_want: to define the days and hours in which I accept appointments
user_story.so_that: owners can only book me when I work

acceptance_criteria.given: a signed-in provider
acceptance_criteria.when: they define their working hours for each working day, which may differ between days
acceptance_criteria.then: pet owners are offered appointment slots only within those days and hours

acceptance_criteria.given: a provider with no working days and hours defined
acceptance_criteria.when: a pet owner tries to book one of its services
acceptance_criteria.then: no appointment slots are offered

acceptance_criteria.given: a signed-in provider defining working hours
acceptance_criteria.when: a start or end time is not on the hour
acceptance_criteria.then: the hours are not saved and the time is indicated

acceptance_criteria.given: a provider with upcoming appointments
acceptance_criteria.when: they change their working hours so that some appointments fall outside them
acceptance_criteria.then: those appointments are cancelled and shown as cancelled to both parties

user_story.i_want: to publish a service with its name, price, the species it applies to and where I offer it
user_story.so_that: pet owners can find it and book appointments

acceptance_criteria.given: a signed-in clinic
acceptance_criteria.when: it publishes a service with a name, a price, one species (dog or cat) and a modality (clinic, home, or both)
acceptance_criteria.then: the service appears in their catalog, on their profile and in search results

acceptance_criteria.given: a signed-in provider publishing a service
acceptance_criteria.when: they do not indicate exactly one species
acceptance_criteria.then: the service is not published and the species is indicated as required

acceptance_criteria.given: a signed-in provider publishing a service
acceptance_criteria.when: they do not indicate a modality
acceptance_criteria.then: the service is not published and the modality is indicated as required

acceptance_criteria.given: a signed-in provider publishing a service
acceptance_criteria.when: they do not indicate a price
acceptance_criteria.then: the service is not published and the price is indicated as required (P02-ASM-014)

acceptance_criteria.given: a signed-in independent veterinarian
acceptance_criteria.when: they publish a service
acceptance_criteria.then: the service is offered only at the owner's home; the clinic and both modalities cannot be chosen

user_story.i_want: to change the details of one of my services
user_story.so_that: my catalog stays up to date

acceptance_criteria.given: a signed-in provider with a published service
acceptance_criteria.when: they change its details and save
acceptance_criteria.then: the updated details appear in their catalog, on their profile and in search results

acceptance_criteria.given: a signed-in provider
acceptance_criteria.when: they try to change a service of another provider
acceptance_criteria.then: the change is not allowed

user_story.i_want: to remove a service I no longer offer
user_story.so_that: pet owners cannot book it

acceptance_criteria.given: a signed-in provider with a published service
acceptance_criteria.when: they remove it
acceptance_criteria.then: the service no longer appears in their catalog, on their profile or in search results, and new appointments for it cannot be booked

acceptance_criteria.given: a removed service that had upcoming appointments
acceptance_criteria.when: the owners and the provider open their appointments
acceptance_criteria.then: those appointments are shown as cancelled

user_story.i_want: to publish a product with its name, price and the species it applies to
user_story.so_that: pet owners can find it and order it

acceptance_criteria.given: a signed-in provider
acceptance_criteria.when: they publish a product with a name, a price and one species (dog or cat)
acceptance_criteria.then: the product appears in their catalog, on their profile and in search results

acceptance_criteria.given: a signed-in provider publishing a product
acceptance_criteria.when: they do not indicate exactly one species
acceptance_criteria.then: the product is not published and the species is indicated as required

acceptance_criteria.given: a signed-in provider publishing a product
acceptance_criteria.when: they do not indicate a price
acceptance_criteria.then: the product is not published and the price is indicated as required (P02-ASM-014)

user_story.i_want: to change the details of one of my products
user_story.so_that: my catalog stays up to date

acceptance_criteria.given: a signed-in provider with a published product
acceptance_criteria.when: they change its details and save
acceptance_criteria.then: the updated details appear in their catalog, on their profile and in search results

acceptance_criteria.given: a signed-in provider
acceptance_criteria.when: they try to change a product of another provider
acceptance_criteria.then: the change is not allowed

user_story.i_want: to remove a product I no longer offer
user_story.so_that: pet owners cannot order it

acceptance_criteria.given: a signed-in provider with a published product
acceptance_criteria.when: they remove it
acceptance_criteria.then: the product no longer appears in their catalog, on their profile or in search results, and it cannot be ordered

acceptance_criteria.given: a removed product with orders that were placed before its removal
acceptance_criteria.when: the owner or the provider opens their orders
acceptance_criteria.then: those orders keep their current status (P02-ASM-012)

user_story.i_want: to search by text the services and products offered by all providers
user_story.so_that: I can find what my pet needs in one place without using other channels

acceptance_criteria.given: services and products published by several providers
acceptance_criteria.when: a signed-in pet owner searches by text
acceptance_criteria.then: the results include offerings from all providers whose name matches the text (P02-ASM-013), with no filtering by the owner's location

acceptance_criteria.given: a list of search results
acceptance_criteria.when: the pet owner looks at a result
acceptance_criteria.then: it shows its price, whether it is offered by a clinic or an independent veterinarian and, for a service, whether it is offered at the clinic, at home, or both

acceptance_criteria.given: no offering matches the search
acceptance_criteria.when: the pet owner searches
acceptance_criteria.then: they are told that there are no results

user_story.i_want: to filter the results by the species a service or product is for
user_story.so_that: I only see offerings that apply to the animal I am looking for

acceptance_criteria.given: search results that include offerings for dogs and for cats
acceptance_criteria.when: the pet owner selects a species filter (dog or cat)
acceptance_criteria.then: only offerings for that species are shown

acceptance_criteria.given: a pet owner who has no registered pet of a given species
acceptance_criteria.when: they filter by that species
acceptance_criteria.then: the offerings for that species are shown anyway

acceptance_criteria.given: a species filter is applied
acceptance_criteria.when: the pet owner removes the filter
acceptance_criteria.then: offerings for both species are shown again

acceptance_criteria.given: a text search with results
acceptance_criteria.when: the pet owner also applies a species filter
acceptance_criteria.then: only results that match both the text and the species are shown

user_story.i_want: to see a provider's details and everything it offers
user_story.so_that: I can decide whether to book or order and know how to reach it

acceptance_criteria.given: a provider that has completed its profile
acceptance_criteria.when: a pet owner opens it
acceptance_criteria.then: they see its name, address, phone, email, provider type, and its services and products with their prices

acceptance_criteria.given: a provider without an address
acceptance_criteria.when: a pet owner opens its profile
acceptance_criteria.then: the profile is shown without an address

items.title: Book an appointment for my pet

user_story.i_want: to book a one-hour appointment for one of my pets for a service I found
user_story.so_that: my pet receives the service

acceptance_criteria.given: a signed-in pet owner with at least one pet viewing a service
acceptance_criteria.when: they start a booking
acceptance_criteria.then: they are shown available one-hour slots only within the provider's working days and hours

acceptance_criteria.given: a pet owner who has chosen one of their pets and an available slot
acceptance_criteria.when: they book
acceptance_criteria.then: the appointment is scheduled immediately, with no confirmation by the provider, and appears in the owner's and the provider's appointments

acceptance_criteria.given: a signed-in pet owner with no registered pets
acceptance_criteria.when: they try to book a service
acceptance_criteria.then: the booking is not allowed and they are told to register a pet first

acceptance_criteria.given: a clinic that already has an appointment in a slot within its working hours
acceptance_criteria.when: another pet owner views that clinic's slots
acceptance_criteria.then: that slot is still offered

acceptance_criteria.given: an independent veterinarian that already has an appointment in a slot
acceptance_criteria.when: another pet owner views that veterinarian's slots
acceptance_criteria.then: that slot is not offered

acceptance_criteria.given: a pet owner viewing available slots
acceptance_criteria.when: the list is shown
acceptance_criteria.then: slots whose start time has already passed are not offered (P02-ASM-006)

acceptance_criteria.given: a pet owner with pets of different species booking a service for one species
acceptance_criteria.when: they choose the pet
acceptance_criteria.then: only their pets of the service's species can be chosen

acceptance_criteria.given: a pet owner with no pet of the service's species
acceptance_criteria.when: they try to book that service
acceptance_criteria.then: the booking is not allowed and they are told the service is only for the other species

user_story.i_want: to give my address when I book a service at home
user_story.so_that: the provider knows where to attend my pet

acceptance_criteria.given: a pet owner booking a service offered at home
acceptance_criteria.when: they enter the visit address and book
acceptance_criteria.then: the appointment is scheduled with that address, and the provider can see it

acceptance_criteria.given: a pet owner booking a service at home
acceptance_criteria.when: they do not enter an address
acceptance_criteria.then: the appointment is not booked and the address is indicated as required

acceptance_criteria.given: a clinic service offered both at the clinic and at home
acceptance_criteria.when: the pet owner books it
acceptance_criteria.then: they choose the modality, and an address is required only if they choose home (P02-ASM-005)

user_story.i_want: to see my appointments
user_story.so_that: I know when and where each one takes place, including changes made by the provider

acceptance_criteria.given: a signed-in pet owner with appointments
acceptance_criteria.when: they open their appointments
acceptance_criteria.then: each one shows the service, provider, pet, date and time, modality and status

acceptance_criteria.given: an appointment that the provider has rescheduled
acceptance_criteria.when: the pet owner opens their appointments
acceptance_criteria.then: it shows the new date and time (no notification is sent: P01-OOS-004)

acceptance_criteria.given: an appointment cancelled by the owner, by the provider or automatically
acceptance_criteria.when: the pet owner opens their appointments
acceptance_criteria.then: it is shown as cancelled

user_story.i_want: to cancel an appointment
user_story.so_that: I am not expected when I can no longer attend

acceptance_criteria.given: a pet owner with an appointment that has not started
acceptance_criteria.when: they cancel it
acceptance_criteria.then: it is shown as cancelled in the owner's and the provider's appointments

acceptance_criteria.given: a cancelled appointment with an independent veterinarian
acceptance_criteria.when: another pet owner views that veterinarian's slots
acceptance_criteria.then: the freed slot is offered again

acceptance_criteria.given: an appointment whose start time has passed
acceptance_criteria.when: the pet owner tries to cancel it
acceptance_criteria.then: the cancellation is not allowed

user_story.i_want: to move an appointment to another date and time
user_story.so_that: I can keep the appointment when my plans change

acceptance_criteria.given: a pet owner with an appointment that has not started
acceptance_criteria.when: they choose another available slot
acceptance_criteria.then: the appointment moves to the new date and time in both parties' appointments

acceptance_criteria.given: a pet owner rescheduling
acceptance_criteria.when: the slots are shown
acceptance_criteria.then: only slots available under the same rules as a new booking are offered

acceptance_criteria.given: an appointment whose start time has passed
acceptance_criteria.when: the pet owner tries to reschedule it
acceptance_criteria.then: the change is not allowed

user_story.i_want: to see the appointments owners have booked with me
user_story.so_that: I know what I have to attend and where

acceptance_criteria.given: a signed-in provider with booked appointments
acceptance_criteria.when: they open their appointments space
acceptance_criteria.then: they see each appointment with its service, date and time, pet, owner's name, modality, status and, for home visits, the address (P02-ASM-008)

acceptance_criteria.given: a signed-in provider
acceptance_criteria.when: they open their appointments space
acceptance_criteria.then: appointments of other providers are not shown

acceptance_criteria.given: an appointment cancelled by the owner, by the provider or automatically
acceptance_criteria.when: the provider opens their appointments space
acceptance_criteria.then: it is shown as cancelled

items.title: Cancel an appointment as a provider

user_story.i_want: to cancel an appointment booked with me
user_story.so_that: I am not expected to attend an appointment I cannot keep

acceptance_criteria.given: a provider with an appointment that has not started
acceptance_criteria.when: they cancel it
acceptance_criteria.then: it is shown as cancelled in the provider's appointments, and the pet owner sees it as cancelled when they open their appointments

acceptance_criteria.given: an appointment whose start time has passed
acceptance_criteria.when: the provider tries to cancel it
acceptance_criteria.then: the cancellation is not allowed

items.title: Reschedule an appointment as a provider

user_story.i_want: to move an appointment booked with me to another date and time
user_story.so_that: I can keep it when my schedule changes

acceptance_criteria.given: a provider with an appointment that has not started
acceptance_criteria.when: they move it to another available slot within their working hours
acceptance_criteria.then: the appointment shows the new date and time in both parties' appointments

acceptance_criteria.given: an appointment whose start time has passed
acceptance_criteria.when: the provider tries to reschedule it
acceptance_criteria.then: the change is not allowed

items.title: Order a product to my address

user_story.i_want: to order a product to my address
user_story.so_that: I receive it without paying online or going elsewhere

acceptance_criteria.given: a signed-in pet owner viewing an available product
acceptance_criteria.when: they choose a quantity from 1 to 99, enter a delivery address and place the order
acceptance_criteria.then: the order for that product and quantity is registered directly with status Confirmed, with no request, reservation or payment step, the total (price × quantity) was shown before ordering, and both the owner and the provider can see it

acceptance_criteria.given: a pet owner placing an order
acceptance_criteria.when: they do not enter a delivery address
acceptance_criteria.then: the order is not placed and the address is indicated as required

acceptance_criteria.given: a signed-in pet owner with no registered pets
acceptance_criteria.when: they order a product
acceptance_criteria.then: the order is placed (pets are required only to book services: P02-ASM-009)

acceptance_criteria.given: a product marked as not available
acceptance_criteria.when: a pet owner tries to order it
acceptance_criteria.then: the order is not allowed

acceptance_criteria.given: a pet owner placing an order
acceptance_criteria.when: the quantity is less than 1 or greater than 99
acceptance_criteria.then: the order is not placed and the quantity is indicated as invalid

items.title: See the product orders placed with me

user_story.i_want: to see the orders owners place for my products
user_story.so_that: I know what to deliver and where

acceptance_criteria.given: a provider with orders placed for its products
acceptance_criteria.when: they open their orders
acceptance_criteria.then: they see each order with the product, the quantity, the owner's name, the delivery address and the status

acceptance_criteria.given: a signed-in provider
acceptance_criteria.when: they open their orders
acceptance_criteria.then: orders placed with other providers are not shown

user_story.i_want: to see my product orders and their status
user_story.so_that: I know whether each order is confirmed, on its way or delivered

acceptance_criteria.given: a signed-in pet owner with orders
acceptance_criteria.when: they open their orders
acceptance_criteria.then: each order shows the product, the quantity, the provider, the delivery address and the status

acceptance_criteria.given: two different pet owners
acceptance_criteria.when: one of them opens their orders
acceptance_criteria.then: only their own orders are shown

items.title: Update the status of an order

user_story.i_want: to move an order forward when I dispatch it and when it is delivered
user_story.so_that: the owner knows where their order is

acceptance_criteria.given: an order with status Confirmed
acceptance_criteria.when: the provider marks it as dispatched
acceptance_criteria.then: its status becomes Dispatched/In delivery, and the owner sees the new status

acceptance_criteria.given: an order with status Dispatched/In delivery
acceptance_criteria.when: the provider marks it as delivered
acceptance_criteria.then: its status becomes Closed

acceptance_criteria.given: an order in any status
acceptance_criteria.when: the provider tries to move it back to an earlier status or skip a status
acceptance_criteria.then: the change is not allowed

acceptance_criteria.given: a signed-in pet owner viewing one of their orders
acceptance_criteria.when: they try to change its status
acceptance_criteria.then: the change is not allowed

user_story.i_want: to cancel an order that has not been dispatched
user_story.so_that: I do not receive a product I no longer want

acceptance_criteria.given: a pet owner with an order with status Confirmed
acceptance_criteria.when: they cancel it
acceptance_criteria.then: the order is cancelled and shown as cancelled to the owner and the provider (P02-ASM-011)

acceptance_criteria.given: an order with status Dispatched/In delivery or Closed
acceptance_criteria.when: the pet owner tries to cancel it
acceptance_criteria.then: the cancellation is not allowed

items.title: Cancel an order as a provider

user_story.i_want: to cancel an order placed with me that has not been dispatched
user_story.so_that: I am not expected to deliver an order I cannot fulfil

acceptance_criteria.given: a provider with an order with status Confirmed
acceptance_criteria.when: they cancel it
acceptance_criteria.then: the order is cancelled and shown as cancelled to the provider and the owner (P02-ASM-011)

acceptance_criteria.given: an order with status Dispatched/In delivery or Closed
acceptance_criteria.when: the provider tries to cancel it
acceptance_criteria.then: the cancellation is not allowed

items.title: Indicate whether a product is in stock

user_story.i_want: to mark each of my products as available or not available
user_story.so_that: owners cannot order products I do not have

acceptance_criteria.given: a published product
acceptance_criteria.when: the provider marks it as not available
acceptance_criteria.then: owners can still see it but cannot order it (P02-ASM-016)

acceptance_criteria.given: a product marked as not available
acceptance_criteria.when: the provider marks it as available again
acceptance_criteria.then: owners can order it

acceptance_criteria.given: a signed-in provider
acceptance_criteria.when: they publish a new product
acceptance_criteria.then: the product is published as available

user_story.i_want: to sign out from the menu of my interface
user_story.so_that: nobody else can use my account on this device, and I can sign in again with another account type

acceptance_criteria.given: a signed-in pet owner or provider
acceptance_criteria.when: they select sign out in the menu
acceptance_criteria.then: the session ends without a confirmation dialog and they are taken to the sign-in screen

acceptance_criteria.given: a user who has signed out
acceptance_criteria.when: they try to open a screen of their interface
acceptance_criteria.then: they are asked to sign in again

user_story.i_want: to say what service or product I need instead of typing it
user_story.so_that: I can search quickly from my phone even when my hands are busy

acceptance_criteria.given: a signed-in pet owner on the search screen, in a browser that supports voice input
acceptance_criteria.when: they choose the microphone and say "busco vacunación para mi perro"
acceptance_criteria.then: the search runs with the text "vacunación" and the species filter set to dog, and the results are the same as typing "vacunación" with the dog filter

acceptance_criteria.given: a pet owner who has started a voice search
acceptance_criteria.when: the platform is listening
acceptance_criteria.then: a visible listening state is shown and the owner can stop listening

acceptance_criteria.given: a voice search has been interpreted
acceptance_criteria.when: the results are shown
acceptance_criteria.then: the search box contains the interpreted text, the species filter shows the interpreted species, and the owner can see what was heard

acceptance_criteria.given: the interpreted text is shown in the search box
acceptance_criteria.when: the owner edits it and searches again
acceptance_criteria.then: the search runs with the edited text, as a typed search

acceptance_criteria.given: a pet owner says a phrase that mentions no species, such as "necesito un baño"
acceptance_criteria.when: the phrase is interpreted
acceptance_criteria.then: the search runs with the text "baño" and the species filter is not changed by the phrase

acceptance_criteria.given: a pet owner says a phrase in which, after removing filler words and species words, no text remains (for example "para mi gato")
acceptance_criteria.when: the phrase is interpreted
acceptance_criteria.then: no search is run and the owner is asked to say or type the service or product they need

acceptance_criteria.given: a pet owner starts a voice search
acceptance_criteria.when: nothing is recognized
acceptance_criteria.then: no search is run and the owner is told that nothing was heard and can retry or type

acceptance_criteria.given: a browser that does not support voice input
acceptance_criteria.when: a pet owner opens the search screen
acceptance_criteria.then: the microphone control is not shown and typed search works as before

acceptance_criteria.given: a pet owner who denies microphone permission
acceptance_criteria.when: they try to search by voice
acceptance_criteria.then: they are told that the microphone is not allowed and typed search remains available

user_story.i_want: to ask the VetCare Assistant questions by voice or by typing and see the conversation
user_story.so_that: I can get information about the platform without navigating several screens

acceptance_criteria.given: a signed-in pet owner
acceptance_criteria.when: they open the assistant from their interface
acceptance_criteria.then: a conversation view is shown with a text input and, if the browser supports voice input, a microphone control

acceptance_criteria.given: the assistant is open
acceptance_criteria.when: the owner types a question and sends it
acceptance_criteria.then: the question and the assistant's answer are added to the conversation

acceptance_criteria.given: the assistant is open in a browser that supports voice input
acceptance_criteria.when: the owner asks a question by voice
acceptance_criteria.then: the recognized question is shown in the conversation and answered in the same way as a typed question

acceptance_criteria.given: a conversation with the assistant
acceptance_criteria.when: the owner leaves the assistant or reloads the page
acceptance_criteria.then: the conversation is not kept, and no audio, transcription or conversation is stored by the platform

acceptance_criteria.given: a signed-in provider
acceptance_criteria.when: they use their interface
acceptance_criteria.then: the assistant is not offered and cannot be used

acceptance_criteria.given: the owner asks the assistant to book, cancel, reschedule or change something
acceptance_criteria.when: the assistant answers
acceptance_criteria.then: it performs no action, explains that it can only give information, and points to the screen where the action can be done

user_story.i_want: to ask the assistant which veterinary clinics and veterinarians are available and the contact details and working hours of one of them
user_story.so_that: I can choose a provider quickly

acceptance_criteria.given: there are published providers
acceptance_criteria.when: the owner asks "¿Qué veterinarias hay?"
acceptance_criteria.then: the assistant answers with the total number of providers and lists up to 5 of them with their name and type (clinic or independent veterinarian), each linking to its public profile

acceptance_criteria.given: there are clinics and independent veterinarians
acceptance_criteria.when: the owner asks only for clinics or only for home-visit / independent veterinarians
acceptance_criteria.then: only providers of that type are counted and listed

acceptance_criteria.given: a provider named "Clínica Patitas" with working days and hours
acceptance_criteria.when: the owner asks "¿Cuál es el horario de Clínica Patitas?"
acceptance_criteria.then: the assistant answers with that provider's working days and hours and links to its public profile

acceptance_criteria.given: a provider with a phone, an email and an address
acceptance_criteria.when: the owner asks where it is or how to contact it
acceptance_criteria.then: the assistant answers with the information of its public profile (address if provided, phone and email)

acceptance_criteria.given: the name in the question matches several providers
acceptance_criteria.when: the assistant answers
acceptance_criteria.then: it lists up to 5 matching providers and asks the owner to be more specific

acceptance_criteria.given: the name in the question matches no provider
acceptance_criteria.when: the assistant answers
acceptance_criteria.then: it says that it did not find that provider and does not show another provider's information

items.title: Ask the assistant about services, products and prices

user_story.i_want: to ask the assistant who offers a service or product, optionally for dogs or cats, and how much it costs
user_story.so_that: I can compare options without searching manually

acceptance_criteria.given: published services named "Vacunación"
acceptance_criteria.when: the owner asks "¿Quién ofrece vacunación?"
acceptance_criteria.then: the assistant answers with the total number of matching offerings and lists up to 5 with their name, price, species and provider, using the same matching as the text search

acceptance_criteria.given: matching offerings for dogs and for cats
acceptance_criteria.when: the owner asks "¿Qué servicios de baño hay para gatos?"
acceptance_criteria.then: only offerings for cats are counted and listed

acceptance_criteria.given: matching offerings
acceptance_criteria.when: the owner asks "¿Cuánto cuesta una consulta?"
acceptance_criteria.then: the assistant answers with the prices of up to 5 matching offerings, each with its provider

acceptance_criteria.given: more than 5 matching offerings
acceptance_criteria.when: the assistant answers
acceptance_criteria.then: it says how many there are in total and offers a link to the search results for that text and species

acceptance_criteria.given: no offering matches
acceptance_criteria.when: the assistant answers
acceptance_criteria.then: it says that it found no service or product for that request

items.title: Ask the assistant about my next appointments

user_story.i_want: to ask the assistant when my next appointments are
user_story.so_that: I can remember them without opening my appointments list

acceptance_criteria.given: a pet owner with upcoming scheduled appointments
acceptance_criteria.when: they ask "¿Cuándo es mi próxima cita?"
acceptance_criteria.then: the assistant answers with their nearest upcoming appointments (up to 5, nearest first), each with date, time, service, provider and pet, and links to their appointments

acceptance_criteria.given: a pet owner with no upcoming scheduled appointments
acceptance_criteria.when: they ask about their appointments
acceptance_criteria.then: the assistant says they have no upcoming appointments

acceptance_criteria.given: cancelled appointments and appointments whose time has passed
acceptance_criteria.when: the assistant answers about upcoming appointments
acceptance_criteria.then: those appointments are not included

acceptance_criteria.given: appointments of other pet owners
acceptance_criteria.when: a pet owner asks about appointments
acceptance_criteria.then: only their own appointments are used in the answer

user_story.i_want: the assistant to tell me what I can ask and to guide me when it does not understand
user_story.so_that: I can get useful answers

acceptance_criteria.given: the assistant is open
acceptance_criteria.when: the owner asks "Ayuda" or "¿Qué puedo preguntarte?"
acceptance_criteria.then: the assistant answers with example questions for each kind of question it supports

acceptance_criteria.given: a question the assistant does not recognize
acceptance_criteria.when: it answers
acceptance_criteria.then: it says that it did not understand, shows example questions and suggests using the search

acceptance_criteria.given: a question outside the platform's information, such as medical advice for a pet
acceptance_criteria.when: the assistant answers
acceptance_criteria.then: it does not give that advice and answers as an unrecognized question, suggesting to book a service with a provider

acceptance_criteria.given: the assistant is opened for the first time in a visit
acceptance_criteria.when: the conversation view is shown
acceptance_criteria.then: it starts with a short greeting that includes example questions

user_story.i_want: the assistant to read its answers aloud and to be able to mute it
user_story.so_that: I can get the information without reading the screen

acceptance_criteria.given: voice replies are on and the browser supports voice output
acceptance_criteria.when: the assistant answers a question
acceptance_criteria.then: the answer is shown as text and read aloud in Spanish

acceptance_criteria.given: the assistant is reading an answer
acceptance_criteria.when: the owner chooses stop
acceptance_criteria.then: the reading stops and the text remains visible

acceptance_criteria.given: voice replies are on
acceptance_criteria.when: the owner mutes them
acceptance_criteria.then: later answers are shown as text only until the owner turns voice replies on again

acceptance_criteria.given: the owner opens the assistant for the first time on a device
acceptance_criteria.when: the first answer is given
acceptance_criteria.then: voice replies are on by default

acceptance_criteria.given: the assistant is reading an answer
acceptance_criteria.when: the owner asks a new question
acceptance_criteria.then: the current reading stops and the new answer is read

acceptance_criteria.given: a browser that does not support voice output
acceptance_criteria.when: the assistant answers
acceptance_criteria.then: the answer is shown as text only and the voice reply controls are not shown

items.title: Listen to a provider's profile or an appointment

user_story.i_want: to listen to a summary of a provider's profile or of one of my appointments
user_story.so_that: I can review it without reading the screen

acceptance_criteria.given: a pet owner viewing a provider's public profile in a browser that supports voice output
acceptance_criteria.when: they choose "Escuchar"
acceptance_criteria.then: a summary with the provider's name, type, address (if provided), phone and number of offerings is read aloud in Spanish

acceptance_criteria.given: a pet owner viewing their appointments
acceptance_criteria.when: they choose "Escuchar" on one appointment
acceptance_criteria.then: its date, time, service, provider, pet, modality and status are read aloud

acceptance_criteria.given: a reading in progress
acceptance_criteria.when: the owner chooses stop or leaves the screen
acceptance_criteria.then: the reading stops

acceptance_criteria.given: a browser that does not support voice output
acceptance_criteria.when: the owner views a profile or their appointments
acceptance_criteria.then: the "Escuchar" control is not shown
